browser.memory_api: CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage then Runtime.getHeapUsage for the dedicated worker

compression.archive: canonical sorted USTAR mode0644 mtime0 then gzip level9 mtime0
compression.files: independent gzip level9 mtime0; payload bytes only, no HTTP/TLS framing

methods.browser_cold: Fresh context per sample; same browser process and uncontrolled OS caches. DOM mutation observation from navigation; profile-specific startup boundaries are recorded.
methods.browser_memory: Dedicated-worker CDP V8 heap/embedder/backing storage bytes after forced GC, in separate untimed contexts. Excludes page, service worker, cache, process RSS, peak allocations and unreported native/Wasm memory. No transport quiescence is asserted for the compiled adapter.
methods.browser_warm: Installed same-version service-worker cache; untimed warm-up then reload/run observations. Offline reload/output verified separately.
methods.comparison: Same canonical computation, three inputs and stdout. Adapters, source compilation, worker reuse and startup boundaries differ; no universal startup/memory ranking. Full/reduced source rows retain the same engine; only explicit library/data/metadata selection differs.
methods.node_memory: Separate --expose-gc processes: process.memoryUsage bytes after forced GC at imported baseline, compiled registry, completed live session and teardown. Arena peakBytes accounts logical VM/registry allocations, excluding parser/host/V8 RSS. No peak RSS claim.
methods.node_timing: Fresh process per sample: engine module import, first compile/registry/run and repeated runs with fresh registries/arenas. Includes library verification in each compilation. Warm summary is the median of per-process medians; nested runs are not independent processes. No forced GC in timing processes.
